units.source_text: 吟罢亲为念佛，态度异常优美。

en.t: After finishing the chant, he personally recited the Buddha's name, and his manner was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 然后低声诵经：“法界三昧普贤大士……”

en.t: Then he softly recited a sutra: "The great bodhisattva Samantabhadra of the dharmadhatu samadhi..."

units.source_text: 其庄严胜于勤修梵行的法师。

en.t: His solemn dignity surpassed that of monks who diligently cultivated the pure religious life.
